messages:
Sara (Partnerships): Quick pulse — Nimbus + EdgeSI listing needs a last-mile signoff. Are we green on press embargo, partner logos, and staging assets?
Miguel (Marketing): PR timeline looks OK but we still need the final customer quote and the exec quote for the blog. can we get those by EOD tomorrow? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Anika (Product): All product mappings done for free/trial/paid SKUs. Billing testcases passed in staging except tenant creation edge-case. See staging run link: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace/catalog-rollout
Tom (Legal): Need Nimbus trademark approval (logo use) + EdgeSI co-marketing agreement signature. Can Nimbus legal confirm permissions by EOD today? otherwise we delay embargo.
Riley (Design): Hero variants uploaded to staging and mobile responsive tested. Partner badges updated — toggles in CMS ready. Quick preview: <staging.redwood.net/nimbus-edge-badges> :white_check_mark:
Devin (Engineering): FYI we hit a provisioning 502 during end-to-end test (session cookie issue). I'm on a fix now, ETA ~2h. Will re-run smoke tests after patch.
Priya (EdgeSI): We pushed SSO test accounts and the SI integration guide to the shared drive. @Devin please ping if you need sample payloads.
Miguel (Marketing): Also need localized microcopy for FR/DE by Thu morning for landing variants. @Riley can you triage?
Riley (Design): Yep — routing to localization vendor now. expect first pass in 24h.
Tom (Legal): Nimbus legal confirmed logo OK for controlled use. Sending signed addendum via Docusign, I'll DM tracking link.
PressBot: Embargo scheduled: 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z. Reminder set for PR ops 24h prior.
Devin (Engineering): Patch deployed to staging, re-ran provisioning tests — all green now. Rolling the same to canary. :rocket:
Miguel (Marketing): Great — assignables: Customer quote (Ben) — Miguel to chase. Exec quote (Aisha) — Anika to request. Locales — Riley coordinate. PR assets — Sara consolidate.
Sara (Partnerships): Good. Final checklist (please mark done in thread):
```
- Legal signoff (Nimbus/EdgeSI)
- Partner logos uploaded to CMS
- Landing hero + localized microcopy
- Customer + exec quotes
- Staging smoke tests green
- Embargo time confirmed
```
Sara (Partnerships): Owners: Legal=Tom (done incoming), Logos=Riley, Locales=Riley, Quotes=Miguel/Anika, Eng=Devin. Deadline for all items: 2026-04-01 18:00Z. If anything slips, we push embargo. :eyes:
Priya (EdgeSI): We can support a quick partner call if anyone needs assets or quotes today.
Miguel (Marketing): I'll start drafting the blog with placeholders and drop in quotes once we have them.
Sara (Partnerships): Thanks team — please post quick status updates here when your item is complete. I'll close the thread once we hit all ticks. :thumbsup:
